summary: Four technical and data irregularities identified during line-by-line forensic verification and resolved in the GEMSDOE71 pipeline.

irregularities.title: Unflagged float32 sentinel -3.4028235e+38 inside training_features.tif (nodata=None)
irregularities.impact: Because the GeoTIFF nodata tag is None, rasterio.read(masked=True) does not mask the -3.4028235e+38 cells. Linear feature combinations or unclipped scores propagate -3.4e38 into the output array, triggering DrivenData's 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]' rejection.
irregularities.resolution: scripts/prepare_data.py explicitly filters (val <= -1e30) | ~np.isfinite(val) to NaN before robust median/IQR standardization and imputes non-finite footprint cells to 0.0 (the robust median).

irregularities.title: 4,601-pixel footprint mask mismatch between sample_submission.tif (5,167,373 px) and training_features.tif (5,165,852 px)
irregularities.impact: If a competitor defines their valid study mask from training_features.tif (5,165,852 px) and writes NaN outside that mask, 3,061 pixels inside sample_submission.tif's 5,167,373-pixel evaluation mask are NaN. Since IEEE-754 comparisons evaluate (np.nan >= 0.0) & (np.nan <= 1.0) as False, any portal check of ((pred >= 0) & (pred <= 1)).all() on the evaluation mask or full grid raises 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]'.
irregularities.resolution: Primary submission gems71-dpst-hdt-35500dots-20261020T200000Z-fd98afd0-zeros.tif writes 0.0 outside the footprint so all 12,279,160 float32 pixels are finite in {0.0, 1.0}. Companion -nan.tif is masked strictly by sample_submission.tif's 5,167,373-pixel mask.

irregularities.title: 6 of 93 registry rasters are dense blanket lattices or full-footprint continuous surfaces (73.97% to 100.00% 3-px footprint coverage)
irregularities.impact: Because a continuous diagnostic surface has positive values on 100% of footprint pixels (and a 5-px lattice covers 99.87% of footprint pixels within 3 px), any raster's 3-px dot overlap against those controls is tautologically ~1.0 even when Spearman rank correlation is near zero (-0.0002 to 0.1466).
irregularities.resolution: src/gems71/uniqueness.py audits all 93 rasters, enforces |Spearman rho| <= 0.90 across all 93 rasters on both pre-placement surface (max 0.1466) and post-placement dots (max 0.0861), and enforces 3-px dot overlap <= 0.70 across all 87 hypothesis-lane rasters (max 0.4325) while explicitly reporting the 6 blanket/surface controls.

irregularities.title: labels.tif and existing_faults.tif are byte-identical (SHA-256 7ba308cc...); catalogue distance features leak if not recomputed per fold
irregularities.impact: Computing distance-to-fault or tip-stress features on the full existing_faults.tif before splitting folds leaks the withheld target segments (solo AUC > 0.99).
irregularities.resolution: All E1 and E2 evaluations use gems57-pooled-hide-v2 spatially-blocked hide-and-recover folds where K_tip(visible) is computed strictly from fold.visible_faults (solo AUC = 0.7502 <= 0.90).
